items.source: Defines a dedicated converter for this field.
items.translation: 为此字段定义专用转换器。

items.source: This annotation is mainly to be used on properties of type Map<String, Object>. All values in the map are subject to conversions by other registered converters. Nested maps are not supported.
items.translation: 此注解主要用于类型为Map<String, Object>的属性。映射中的所有值均受其他已注册转换器的转换影响。不支持嵌套映射。

items.source:
This annotation is the pendant to Neo4j-OGMs
org.neo4j.ogm.annotation.Properties.
items.translation: 此注解是 Neo4j-OGM 的配套注解 org.neo4j.ogm.annotation.Properties。

items.source: This attribute allows for configuring a transformation that is applied to the maps keys. CompositeProperty.Phase.WRITE is applied before writing the map, CompositeProperty.Phase.READ is applied on write.
items.translation: 该属性允许配置应用于 Map 键的转换。CompositeProperty.Phase.WRITE 在写入 Map 之前应用，CompositeProperty.Phase.READ 则在写入时应用。

items.source:
The default implementation, passing map properties through as they are on the way
to the graph and possibly applying a post processor on the way out of the graph.
items.translation: 默认实现会将图属性原样传递至图，并在离开图时可能应用后处理器。

items.source: The default operation for transforming the keys.
items.translation: 转换键的默认操作。

items.source: Phase of the mapping currently taking place.
items.translation: 当前映射所处的阶段。

items.source:
Allows to specify the delimiter between prefix and map value on the properties of
the node or relationship in the graph.
items.translation: 允许在图节点或关系的属性中指定前缀与映射值之间的分隔符。

items.source: Allows to specify the prefix for the map properties.
items.translation: 允许指定地图属性的前缀。

items.source:
This attribute allows for configuring a transformation that is applied to the maps
keys.
items.translation: 此属性允许配置应用于地图键的转换。

items.source:
Allows to specify the prefix for the map properties. The default empty value
instructs SDN to use the field name of the annotated property.
items.translation: 允许指定地图属性的前缀。默认的空值指示 SDN 使用已注解属性的字段名。

items.source:
Allows to specify the delimiter between prefix and map value on the properties of
the node or relationship in the graph. Defaults to ..
items.translation: 允许指定图节点或关系属性中前缀与映射值之间的分隔符。默认值为 ..

items.source: Michael J. Simons
items.translation: 迈克尔·J·西蒙斯

items.source:
A converter that allows to store arbitrary objects as decomposed maps on
nodes and relationships. The default converter allows only maps as composite
properties.
items.translation: 一个转换器，允许将任意对象存储为节点和关系上的分解映射。默认转换器仅允许将映射作为复合属性使用。

items.source:
The prefix used for storing the properties in the graph on the node or
relationship
items.translation: 用于在节点或关系上存储属性的前缀。

items.source: Delimiter to use in the stored property names
items.translation: 存储属性名称中使用的分隔符

items.source: A transformation to be used on enum keys.
items.translation: 用于枚举键的转换。

items.source: Nested Class Summary
items.translation: 嵌套类摘要

items.source: Optional Element Summary
items.translation: 可选元素摘要

items.source: Element Details
items.translation: 元素详情

items.source: This annotation indicates a persistent property that is composed of multiple properties on a node or relationship. The properties must share a common prefix. SDN defaults to the name of the field declared on the persistent entity.
items.translation: 此注释表示一个持久化属性，该属性由节点或关系上的多个属性组成。这些属性必须具有共同的名称前缀。SDN 默认使用在 持久化实体上声明的字段名称。
